scope: Independent read-only inspection of existing Qwen layer/dose and Llama adapter definitions. This receipt does not certify new code, GPU readiness, formal launch, or model effects.

candidate_model.selection_status: Root requested clarification of Base versus Instruct; this audit addresses the available Instruct adapter.

settings_to_preserve.instruction: 请用中文简短回答，通常一至三句话；具体格式要求以题目为准。
settings_to_preserve.point_sampling: Same frozen seeded uniform sampling without replacement policy, ten distinct valid MLP channels per layer, fixed before viewing outputs. Signs and all magnitudes share every point.
settings_to_preserve.intervention: Add to one gated MLP activation immediately before down_proj; c(d)=d*m/||W_down[:,channel]||_2; no weight edits or cumulative dose.
settings_to_preserve.clean_scale: For each original full prompt, median of each decoder block output per-token L2 norms excluding the first token; fixed per question across all points and signed doses.
settings_to_preserve.bf16: Compute each requested offset independently from original double ratio, then cast to BF16; assert request and rounded offset mirror, but do not demand actual activation delta mirror.
settings_to_preserve.scope: Full prefill and every generation step, fresh context/cache for each question-condition.
settings_to_preserve.output: Keep original tokens and EOS length, including terminator; no padding to128, continuation, semantic filters, or failure overwrites.

necessary_model_differences: Native model class, hidden/MLP size, weights, tokenizer vocabulary and layer attention architecture must remain the official Llama values; channel index is not a cross-model functional identity.
Identical user instruction and question text, but native chat wrappers and token IDs differ. Save exact rendered contexts and input hashes; never force Qwen template or EOS IDs onto Llama.
The existing Llama wrapper pins date_string=26 Oct 2026. Freeze an explicit date instead of wall-clock-dependent template output. Existing BOS logic must yield exactly one native BOS.
Historical official Llama tokenizer receipt has EOS [128001,128008,128009], BOS128000 and pad128009; verify current asset declarations. Qwen EOS248044/248046 must not be copied.
Llama has no Qwen enable_thinking switch: report not_applicable rather than claiming a tested reasoning-mode toggle.
128 model-native tokens match the generation-budget rule, not equal character/semantic lengths. Calibration token positions include different native wrappers and segmentation.
Full signed grid coverage differs: Qwen 1 point/layer versus Llama10. Only the +1 ten-point slice has matching per-layer sampling coverage. Do not pool all answers into cross-model efficacy rankings.
implementation_hazards: CrossFamilyEngine initializes only L13/L14 modules and hashes. New all-layer adapter must replace modules, column_norms and pre/post weight hashes with all32 layers.
Frozen negative DoseEngine allows only negative five doses plus0,+1; new version must allow all symmetric ten nonzero doses without changing the old frozen implementation.

Legacy generate inherits model.generation_config settings beyond explicit do_sample/max_new_tokens/cache/stops. Record and compare effective num_beams, repetition penalties and token suppression settings; no unreported inherited generation modifiers.
Do not require context/calibration identity with historical Qwen records. Cross-model values differ; enforce identity among Llama baselines, controls and all signed conditions.

formal: Freeze new contract/code/questions/samples/assets with immutable authorization and execution identities; launch only after new CPU/GPU controls pass.
Use fresh Llama preflight-derived or independently validated clean baselines/calibrations; actual record groups, not record_count/8, determine completion.

Preserve failures/partials; verify final records/token/hook/weights and complete raw export/archives before technical completion claim.
